segments.tha-ap534:5.3: Sadevamanujākiṇṇe, janamajjhe jinuttamo [januttamo (syā. pī.), anuttamo (ka.) vaṅgīsattherāpadānepi].
segments.tha-ap534:6.3: Rañjayaṃ parisaṃ sabbaṃ, santhavī sāvakaṃ sakaṃ.
segments.tha-ap534:7.3: Natthi etādiso añño, yathāyaṃ bhikkhu vakkali.
segments.tha-ap534:8.3: Hutvā sutvā ca taṃ vākyaṃ, taṃ ṭhānamabhirocayiṃ.
segments.tha-ap534:11.1: “‘Yo so tayā santhavito, ito sattamake muni [idha saddhādhimutto isi (syā.), ito sattamakehani (sī. pī.)];
segments.tha-ap534:11.3: Bhikkhu saddhāvataṃ aggo, tādiso homahaṃ mune’.
segments.tha-ap534:16.3: Gotamo nāma gottena, satthā loke bhavissati.
segments.tha-ap534:17.3: Vakkali nāma nāmena, hessati satthu sāvako’.
segments.tha-ap534:19.3: Sāvatthiyaṃ pure jāto, kule aññatare ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap534:21.3: Imaṃ dadāma te nātha, saraṇaṃ hohi nāyaka.
segments.tha-ap534:22.1: “Tadā paṭiggahi so maṃ, bhītānaṃ saraṇo muni;
segments.tha-ap534:26.1: “Buddharūparatiṃ [buddho rūparatiṃ (sī.)] ñatvā, tadā ovadi maṃ jino;
segments.tha-ap534:27.1: “‘Yo hi passati saddhammaṃ, so maṃ passati paṇḍito;
segments.tha-ap534:27.3: Apassamāno saddhammaṃ, maṃ passampi na passati.
segments.tha-ap534:31.3: Vakkalīti jino vācaṃ, taṃ sutvā mudito ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap534:33.1: “Punopi [punāpi (syā.), muni maṃ (ka.)] dhammaṃ deseti, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ;
segments.tha-ap534:37.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap534:39.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā vakkalitthero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: So arahattaṃ patvā attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento ito satasahassamhītiādimāha.
Tattha itoti kakusandhādīnaṃ uppannabhaddakappato heṭṭhā kappasatasahassamatthaketi attho.
Andhānaṃ nayanūpamoti cakkhuvirahitānaṃ sattānaṃ nayanasadiso, dhammadesanāya sabbasattānaṃ paññācakkhādicakkhudāyakoti attho.
Karuṇāmatiākaroti sādhūnaṃ cittakampanasaṅkhātāya karuṇāya ca atthānatthaminanaparicchinnamatiyā ca ākaro ādhārabhūto.
Brahmāsurasuraccitoti brahmehi ca asurehi ca devehi ca accito pūjitoti attho.
Madhurena rutena cāti karavīkarutamadhurena saddena sakalaṃ janaṃ rañjayantīti sambandho.
Santhavī sāvakaṃ sakanti attano sāvakaṃ madhuradhammadesanāya santhavī, thutiṃ akāsīti attho.
Taṃ ṭhānamabhirocayinti taṃ saddhādhimuttaṭṭhānantaraṃ abhirocayiṃ, icchiṃ patthesinti attho.
Pisācībhayatajjitāti tadā evaṃbhūtaṃ kumāraṃ maṃ aññā pisācī ekā rakkhasī bhayena tajjesi bhiṃsāpesīti attho.
Dīnamānasā bhītacittā mama mātāpitaro imaṃ dārakaṃ te dadāma, imassa saraṇaṃ patiṭṭhā hotu nātha nāyakāti sambandho.

Tadā paṭiggahi so manti so bhagavā tadā tasmiṃ mama mātuyā dinnakāle jālinā jālayuttena saṅkhālakena cakkalakkhaṇādīhi lakkhitena mudukomalapāṇinā mudukena visuddhena hatthatalena maṃ aggahesīti attho.
Sabbasubhākiṇṇaṃ sabbena subhena vaṇṇena saṇṭhānena ākiṇṇaṃ gahanībhūtaṃ rūpaṃ bhagavato hatthapādasīsādirūpaṃ disvāti attho, tittiṃ apatto viharāmi ahanti sambandho.
Tadā maṃ caraṇantagoti tasmiṃ mayhaṃ arahattaṃ pattakāle sīlādipannarasannaṃ caraṇadhammānaṃ antago, pariyosānappatto paripūrakārīti attho.
Tassa maraṇassa antaṃ nibbānaṃ pattoti attho.
Atha satthā bhikkhusaṅghamajjhe nisinno “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ saddhādhimuttānaṃ yadidaṃ, vakkalī”ti (a. ni.1.198,208) maṃ etadaggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesīti vuttaṃ hoti.

Ayampi thero purimajinavaresu katādhikāro tattha tattha bhave vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puññāni upacinanto padumuttarassa bhagavato kāle haṃsavatīnagare kulagehe nibbatto viññutaṃ patto satthu santikaṃ gacchantehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gantvā parisapariyante ṭhito dhammaṃ suṇanto satthārā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ saddhādhimuttānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapitaṃ disvā sayampi taṃ ṭhānantaraṃ patthento sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ datvā paṇidhānaṃ akāsi.
So yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto amhākaṃ bhagavato kāle sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇakule nibbatti, tassa vakkalīti nāmaṃ kariṃsu.
Niddhantasuvaṇṇapiṇḍasadisatāya apagato byapagato kali doso assāti va-kārāgamaṃ katvā vakkalīti vuccati.
So vuddhippatto tayo vede uggaṇhitvā brāhmaṇasippesu nipphattiṃ gato, satthāraṃ disvā rūpakāyasampattidassanena atitto satthārā saddhiṃyeva vicarati.

“Agāramajjhe vasanto niccakālaṃ satthu dassanaṃ na labhissāmī”ti satthu santike pabbajitvā ṭhapetvā bhojanakālaṃ sarīrakiccakālañca sesakāle yattha ṭhitena sakkā dasabalaṃ passituṃ, tattha ṭhito aññaṃ kiccaṃ pahāya bhagavantaṃ olokentoyeva viharati.
Satthā tassa ñāṇaparipākaṃ āgamento bahukālaṃ tasmiṃ rūpadassaneneva vicarante kiñci avatvā punekadivasaṃ –
Yo kho, vakkali, dhammaṃ passati, so maṃ passati;
yo maṃ passati, so dhammaṃ passati.
Dhammañhi, vakkali, passanto maṃ passatī”ti (saṃ. ni.3.87) āha.
Satthari evaṃ vadantepi thero satthu dassanaṃ pahāya aññattha gantuṃ na sakkoti.
Tato satthā,“nāyaṃ bhikkhu saṃvegaṃ alabhitvā bujjhissatī”ti vassūpanāyikadivase –
So satthārā paṇāmito satthu sammukhe ṭhātuṃ asakkonto –
“kiṃ mayhaṃ jīvitena, yohaṃ satthāraṃ daṭṭhuṃ na labhāmī”ti gijjhakūṭe pabbate papātaṭṭhānaṃ abhiruhi?
“ayaṃ bhikkhu mama santikā assāsaṃ alabhanto maggaphalānaṃ upanissayaṃ nāseyyā”ti attānaṃ dassetvā obhāsaṃ vissajjento –
Adhigacche padaṃ santaṃ, saṅkhārūpasamaṃ sukhan”ti.(dha. pa.381)–
Gāthaṃ vatvā “ehi, vakkalī”ti (dha. pa. aṭṭha.2.381) hatthaṃ pasāresi.

Thero “dasabalo me diṭṭho,‘ehī’ti avhāyanampi laddhan”ti balavapītisomanassaṃ uppādetvā “kuto gacchāmī”ti attano gamanabhāvaṃ ajānitvāva satthu sammukhe ākāse pakkhanditvā paṭhamena pādena pabbate ṭhitoyeva satthārā vuttagāthāyo āvajjento ākāseyeva pītiṃ vikkhambhetvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇīti aṅguttaraṭṭhakathāyaṃ (a. ni. aṭṭha.1.1.208) dhammapadavaṇṇanāyañca (dha. pa. aṭṭha.2.381 vakkalittheravatthu) āgataṃ.
“kiṃ te, vakkalī”tiādinā satthārā ovadito gijjhakūṭe viharanto vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapesi, tassa saddhāya balavabhāvato eva vipassanā vīthiṃ na otarati?
Bhagavā taṃ ñatvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ sodhetvā adāsi.
So puna vipassanaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetuṃ nāsakkhiyeva.
Athassa āhāravekallena vātābādho uppajji, taṃ vātābādhena pīḷiyamānaṃ ñatvā bhagavā tattha gantvā pucchanto –
Evaṃ thero vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
